brand.name: ABPT
brand.vibe: Simplistic blend of green, encouraging, fresh, and functional

theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The user requested a simplistic blend of green and an encouraging vibe. Archetype 1 provides the grounded, healthy, and fresh aesthetic needed for meal prep, while bright green accents will inject the fitness/encouragement energy needed for 'bruddatrain'.

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (-0.02em to -0.04em).
Avoid pure black for text; use #111C15 to maintain the earthy tint.
Use text-muted (#5C7063) for secondary descriptions to establish hierarchy.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use expansive padding to let the simplistic UI breathe.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style grids for the weekly menu. Wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8).
spacing_and_layout.borders: Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px borders (border-[#E5EFE8]). No heavy drop shadows. Use shadow-sm for cards.

buttons.primary: bg-[#10B981] text-white rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all hover:bg-[#059669] hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F3F7F4] text-[#1A3622] rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all hover:bg-[#E5EFE8]

cards.style: bg-white border border-[#E5EFE8] rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm

inputs_and_auth.4_digit_input: flex justify-center gap-4. Each input: w-16 h-20 text-center text-3xl font-bold rounded-lg border-2 border-[#E5EFE8] focus:border-[#10B981] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#10B981]/20 outline-none transition-all
inputs_and_auth.general_input: w-full rounded-md border border-[#E5EFE8] px-4 py-3 focus:border-[#10B981] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#10B981] outline-none

navigation.header: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E5EFE8]

hero_image.description: Healthy vegetables stored in plastic containers for fresh and nutritious meals. Use as hero image on landing page.

trainer_vibe.description: Man with arms crossed in a gym. Represents the 'bruddatrain' brand persona.

recipe_chicken_bowl.description: A bowl of rice topped with glazed chicken and vegetables. Use for recipe thumbnails.

ingredients_prep.description: Hands arranging fresh ingredients. Use for the shopping list or weekly menu header.

sections: Hero: Brand Name (ABPT), Tagline (bruddatrain), encouraging H1, CTA 'Access Weekly Plan', Hero image.
How It Works: 3 simple steps (Register, Get Weekly Plan, Prep & Eat).
Auth Section: Client self-registration form OR 4-digit code login.
Header: Greeting, Countdown to code expiry, Profile Access.
Weekly Menu: Mon-Sun Grid (Bento style). Each day shows Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner.
Actions: Prominent 'Download PDF (Plan + Recipes + Shopping List)' button.
Shopping List: Clean, cardless checklist format auto-generated from the week's meals.

recipe_view.layout: 2-column layout on desktop. Left: Large image + instructions. Right: Ingredient list with checkboxes.

sections: Client Management: Table of clients, current 4-digit codes, remove action.
Menu Generator: Interface to set/rotate the Mon-Sun meals and regenerate the shopping list.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure primary CTA (#10B981) has accessible white text. Focus states must use ring-2 focus:ring-[#10B981].
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute. (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn', data-testid='download-pdf-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons.
Use Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, and inputs, but customize the styling to match the flat/subtle border aesthetic described above.
Do not use generic 'Inter' font. Import and configure 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body.
Ensure the PDF generation combines the plan, recipes, and shopping list cleanly. Consider using libraries like 'jspdf' and 'html2canvas' or '@react-pdf/renderer'.
Implement the 4-digit auth system cleanly, restricting access to the dashboard unless a valid, non-expired code is present.
